Tolga Bulucu built his career at sea, moving through successive captaincy assignments from 2008 and working across the Mediterranean and Aegean. His qualifications include an international master licence and chief-officer credentials for cargo and passenger vessels. The progression reflects practical command experience rather than a purely investment-led connection to the maritime industry.

Alongside captaincy, Bulucu operates an eponymous charter business registered with Turkey's Chamber of Shipping in Muğla. Maritime directories also connect his name with custom construction and commercial charter activity. Together, these roles establish him as an active operator in maritime tourism, but his business financing, family background, ownership structure and broader finances remain private.
